object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: Delete an object that test cases in another document link to, then Undo, then Redo. Make one step of two description edits and a create, undo and redo it. Undo and redo the attaching of a figure. Expected: after Undo each file in both documents is byte for byte as before the delete and the object is back; Redo gives the files as after the delete; the three-change step puts back each file, the manifest except for its next object number; undoing the attach removes the figure and the emptied figures folder, and redoing gives the figure's bytes back.
